description: Patents filed by French research institutions. One document is one patent.

co_cpc_classe.description: Cooperative Patent Classification (CPC) class code for the patent.

cpc.description: Cooperative Patent Classification (CPC) metadata for the patent.

classe.description: Container for CPC class-level details of the patent.

code.description: Alphanumeric code identifying the CPC class (e.g., 'A01B').

id_name.description: Unique identifier combining class code and name for precise referencing.

label.description: Human-readable label describing the CPC class (e.g., 'Soil working').

groupe.description: Container for CPC group-level details of the patent.

code.description: Alphanumeric code identifying the CPC group (e.g., 'A01B1/00').

label.description: Human-readable label describing the CPC group (e.g., 'Hand tools').

section.description: Container for CPC section-level details of the patent.

code.description: Single-letter code identifying the CPC section (e.g., 'A').

id_name.description: Top-level CPC section identifier and name (e.g., 'A Human Necessities').

label.description: Human-readable label of the CPC section (e.g., 'Human Necessities').

ss_classe.description: Container for CPC subclass details, including code, ID, and label.

code.description: CPC subclass code (e.g., 'A01B') for precise technical classification.

id_name.description: CPC subclass identifier and name (e.g., 'A01B PLOUGHS OR PLOWING').

label.description: Human-readable label of the CPC subclass (e.g., 'PLOUGHS OR PLOWING').

denormalized_structures.description: Denormalized data about research institutions linked to the patent.
